segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey, can you sanity check Northline before I send the pricing sheet? They're at 82 seats today, want to add 18 for support ops, and finance asked for annual billing instead of quarterly.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Yeah, pulling it up in the CRM. I see the expansion note. Is this the same account with the services go-live on March 10?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: That's them. Implementation is fine, SOW is signed. The weird part is the main subscription. Their agreement ends this Friday, February 28, and I don't see a renewal opp, no extension order form, nothing from deal desk. And as far as I can tell, nobody from our side has actually talked to them about continuing past Friday.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Wait, nobody has had the renewal conversation? Not customer success, not us? That's, yeah, that's not good. If their term ends Friday and we haven't asked whether they're carrying on, we can't just assume the 100 seats roll into the expansion.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Exactly. I checked call notes back to January 6. It's all go-live dates, invoice contacts, and the added seats. No one said, hey, your contract is expiring, do you want a new 12-month term or a short bridge. We're basically at the end date without client confirmation.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Okay. First, don't send pricing like it's a normal add-on. Send a note to Angela and Priya asking for a 30-minute renewal call today or tomorrow. Keep it simple: current term ends February 28, expansion depends on active subscription, need direction on 12 months versus month-to-month bridge.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so I can hold the quote until they answer. For numbers, if they do 100 total seats at the current tier, annual is $72,000 before the 8% uplift. Services already billed at $9,500, invoice went out Monday.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Good. And put the billing contact on there? Last time AP kicked back the PO because the ship-to address had the old Denver office.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, I updated the billing tool with the Phoenix address and net 30. Legal terms are standard, no redlines expected unless they ask for the bridge.

segments.speaker: Evan
segments.text: Alright. Log the outreach in the CRM, tag me if they respond. If they want the 12-month renewal, I can turn the order form same day.
